statement: Coordinate prefill chunks across expert-parallel ranks using decode deadlines
mechanism: At each scheduling step, choose a graph-compatible prefill chunk using the earliest active decode deadline and a predicted iteration cost based on the slowest participating rank. Coordinate the choice across the expert-parallel group so one rank's prefill does not delay another rank's decode collective. This is an untested adaptation of deadline-aware chunking to the candidate DEP8 or DEP4 layouts.

statement: Pressure-aware commit timing for expert rebalancing
mechanism: Keep an already computed expert-placement plan pending while prefill pressure or insufficient free HBM makes its migration expensive. Commit at a bounded later step when the predicted reduction in slow-rank MoE time exceeds migration and queueing cost. This acts on when EPLB moves weights, not on token routing or expert precision.
change: Add a pending-plan state and a commit gate to the existing EPLB controller. Evaluate rank imbalance, pending-plan age, migration bytes, per-rank free HBM, and current prefill/decode pressure before all-rank commit. Keep the old expert map active until every rank acknowledges a complete migration; on timeout retain the old map and retry or discard the plan.
